summary.verdict: Model beat both statistical/rule baselines in 4/4 outer folds, and LOST money on outer validation (mean net return -0.0448), beating CASH — doing nothing — in only 2/4 folds; buy-and-hold returned +0.6063 on the same windows and was beaten in 0/4 folds. Beating majority-class and momentum is a floor test, not evidence of profitability.
